title: Restore full-unit coverage after fixture and stream lifecycle additions
acceptance: The historical Figure Kit study retains its approved SVG goldens while the engine-list guard continues scanning runtime source.
Scheduled field and legacy focal tests supply the real DOM container their Chamber lifecycle requires.
Field transition coverage verifies active image-stream teardown and revocation as well as cue routing.
Focused regression tests and required CI pass before reviewed integration.

evidence.note: Baseline full validation reported the historical Figure Kit fixture as a duplicate engine inventory and two Chamber journey shells without a container.

Reproduced both querySelector failures against main 96df6259 with pinned dependencies; after supplying containers and asserting stream cleanup, the focused three-file run passed all 86 tests. The engine-list failure was separately reproduced before its exact fixture exception. Production source and SVG goldens unchanged.

Default-config run of all 38 Chamber test files plus the engine-list guard and Figure Kit: 40 files, 481 tests passed. New cleanup assertions fail if scheduled-cue stream revocation is removed (mutation restored). Roadmap validation and CI hygiene passed. Full unit/browser suites have not run locally.

summary: Test harness corrections only; no runtime, feature-flag, deployment or human acceptance claim.

activity.summary: Claimed the October 18 full-unit fixture and lifecycle regressions; reproduced all three failures and prepared the narrow test-only correction.
